name: mcdu_tx
note: ARINC 739 — TX side of the LRU. Only the heartbeat label needs a registration: every other LRU→MCDU word uses the MAL learned from the MCDU's ENQ as its label number and is sent through the send_raw_word builtin, which needs no label spec. In root-menu mode the same heartbeat label advertises one SAL per root LRU. (The old per-MAL stanzas — 145/146/220/245/246/312 — were a workaround from before send_raw_word existed.)

lru_id_172.description: ARINC 739A LRU identifier heartbeat (octal label 172 — mandated by ARINC 739A §3.7.1). Data field carries an LRU SAL in bits 9-16 so the MCDU knows which subsystem to ENQ on which input port. Aviologic's pack_dec_no_sdi_no_ssm(122, ...) uses 122 DECIMAL = octal 172 — easy to mis-port. Transmitted periodically.
